{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Define the population: all new customers reached by paid search
# This includes both completed and refunded orders
df_new_paid_search_all = df[
    (df['customer_segment'] == 'new') &
    (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')
]

# Count total number of such customers (orders)
total_count = len(df_new_paid_search_all)

# Count how many of them converted: only completed orders (status == 'completed')
converted_count = df_new_paid_search_all['converted'].sum()

# Compute conversion rate
conversion_rate = converted_count / total_count

# Print results
print(f'Total new customers reached by paid search: {total_count}')
print(f'Converted orders: {converted_count}')
print(f'Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}')"}
